summary: Iteration 51: Video Sprite Generation Bug Fix Verification. Backend: 13/13 tests passed. The bug fix for Cloudinary-stored videos not getting sprites is working correctly. Test videos (dd417d50-1b8f-443f-b97e-6db910a664a0 via simple upload, bdddade5-95ea-432d-b75b-bbb7929b494d via chunked upload) both have sprite_ready=True and valid sprite files.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (video player opens, quality badges visible, progress bar functional)

seed_data_creation: Used existing test videos uploaded by main agent: dd417d50-1b8f-443f-b97e-6db910a664a0 (simple upload) and bdddade5-95ea-432d-b75b-bbb7929b494d (chunked upload)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Video sprite generation bug fix verified. Key findings: 1) POST /api/personal-files/auth with password 'GenSutSu.1999' returns success. 2) GET /api/personal-files/files returns files with sprite_ready field - test videos have sprite_ready=True. 3) GET /api/personal-files/sprites/{file_id}/sprite.jpg returns 200 with valid JPEG (8-11KB). 4) GET /api/personal-files/sprites/{file_id}/thumbs.vtt returns valid WEBVTT with sprite coordinates. 5) Frontend VideoPlayer loads at /admin/personal-files, shows quality badges (480p, 240p, 720p, 1080p), progress bar visible. 6) Sprite files stored in /app/backend/uploads/personal/sprites/. 7) Older videos without sprites have sprite_ready=null.

backend_apis.GET /api/personal-files/files: PASS - returns files with sprite_ready field

bug_fix_verification.original_bug: Cloudinary-stored videos never got sprites because temp file was deleted before sprite generation could run
bug_fix_verification.fix_applied: Temp file is now preserved until sprite generation completes (cleanup_path parameter in _generate_sprite)
